chunks: Sama'ah narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Have taqwa of Allah regarding the two weak ones.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, the Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.رَوَى: narrated; indicates transmission of the report
key_terms.سَمَاعَةُ: Sama'ah, the transmitter of this hadith
key_terms.ٱتَّقُوا: have taqwa; be God-conscious and wary of violating Allah’s command
key_terms.ٱلضَّعِيفَيْنِ: the two weak ones; the vulnerable persons referred to in the hadith
key_terms.ٱللَّهَ: Allah, before whom one is morally accountable

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith "Fear Allah regarding the two weak ones" mean?
ai.summary: This hadith is a brief exhortation commanding believers to exercise taqwa in how they deal with the vulnerable. It emphasizes moral responsibility toward those who are socially or physically weak and calls for protection of their rights.
